messages:
maria_support: BrightFuture (bf-777) just hit 429s at their monthly refill. They expected a midnight CET refill but kept getting quota_exhausted. Customer in prod, pretty urgent.

ops-bot: scheduled_refill attempted for tenant bf-777 at 2026-04-01T00:00:05+01:00 -> SKIPPED (reason=feature_flag:new_billing_v2=true)

jake_sre: @maria_support can you paste a short log sample and confirm their billing tz & window?

maria_support: Log snippet:
```
2026-04-01T00:00:10+01:00 bf-777 api_gateway 429 quota_exhausted monthly_balance=0
{"error":"quota_exhausted","message":"monthly credits depleted"}
```
Tenant metadata: billing_tz=Europe/Berlin, billing_window=monthly 00:00 local.

noah_engineer: Quick DB check from prod-replica:
```
SELECT tenant_id, last_refill_at, flags ->> 'new_billing_v2' as nbv FROM tenant_quotas WHERE tenant_id='bf-777';
-- result: last_refill_at=NULL, nbv=true
```

emily_eng: Ops-bot SKIP is from the new_billing_v2 canary gating. Looks like the rollback automation didn't clear the canary for some tenants, so scheduler skipped them.

lee_billing: If last_refill_at is NULL some scheduler code paths treat that as no-op. Combined with SKIP we left them at 0. Recommend emergency refill and reconciliation.

carla_finance: Finance ok with an emergency one-off credit. Please open a reconciliation ticket and tag us.

noah_engineer: Performing admin refill and will flip the flag for the tenant after. Command: \n``\ncurl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN\" \\n  https://api.redwood.ai/admin/tenants/bf-777/refill \\n  -d '{"tokens":500000,"reason":"emergency refill after scheduled-refill-skip"}'\n```

ops-bot: admin_refill completed for tenant bf-777 at 2026-04-01T00:05:12+01:00 (amount=500000)

maria_support: Customer verified success at 00:06 CET and resumed traffic. They want root cause and fix ETA.

emily_eng: Root cause (short): a canary rollout for new_billing_v2 introduced a scheduler gate. Due to rollout race some tenants kept the flag without billing anchors. Scheduler returned SKIPPED for those tenants. Impact: a small % of canary tenants did not get monthly refill.

jake_sre: Actions: emily/eng-migrations to make canary gating idempotent and treat NULL last_refill_at as needing refill (INF-4802). infra to alert when SKIPPED + NULL last_refill_at. billing to open finance ticket TICKET-8745. support to send customer note + offer 1:1.

maria_support: Draft note to customer: "We identified an issue where a canary billing flag prevented your scheduled refill. We've issued an emergency refill so service is restored and are deploying a fix to prevent recurrence. We'll follow up with a reconciliation of the ad-hoc credit. Apologies for the disruption."

carla_finance: Fine to send. Reconciliation timeline: ~3 business days, ticket attached.

emily_eng: Deployed scheduler fix at 2026-04-01T02:12:00Z. Refill worker re-run completed 02:30Z. Added unit & integration tests.

noah_engineer: Post-fix checks: tenant record now last_refill_at=2026-04-01T00:05:12+01:00, nbv=true, next scheduled refill 2026-05-01T00:00:00+01:00.

maria_support: Closing loop with customer now. Internally tracked in INF-4802. Leaving thread open 24h for monitoring.

ops-bot: monitoring alert rule:billing_refill_skips triggered for 3 tenants at 2026-04-01T00:00:05+01:00 (investigation ongoing)

maria_support: Thanks all — will escalate if pattern grows.
